_comment: sim-robust-movegroup-estop-retry-v1 bounded GPU proof config for the integration lane (twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1). Purpose: prove that a move_group PROCESS death during a manipulation op -- including mid-replan at the collect STOW, the exact point the coldlive capstone died (host-stack.log line 11535, pid 1770443, exit code -6, 'malloc(): unaligned tcache chunk detected') -- now routes through respawn + planning-scene re-sync + a bounded retry of the interrupted plan instead of an immediate 'host emergency stop'. This EXTENDS sim-robust-movegroup-respawn-v1 (PR #224): PR #224 re-syncs the scene on the two crash-retry sites (server-down poll + plan-result wall-deadline); coldlive still e-stopped because the death surfaced as a RAISE inside poll() (an ABORTED result with no payload / a lost-server result future) that went straight to stop() -> emergency_stop(). This lane catches that raise: when the move_group action server for the current state is GONE and crash-retry budget remains, poll() HOLDS the move open (arm keeps its last commanded pose, weld intact) so the existing _handle_server_crash owns the respawn wait + re-sync + re-send.
_how_to_run: scripts/run_mobile_restock.py ... --stop-after collect  (the STOW is the last collect move, so a collect-only run reaches it; the place-on-cart replan / cuMotion OOM owned by other lanes is never entered). One GPU run at a time through flock /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, never --force; do not touch the whispr service (pid 1339, ~2.2 GB VRAM). Honest collect (RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH unset) reproduces the coldlive live_pose stress most faithfully; the ground-truth shortcut (RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1) is a faster, more deterministic carry+stow for a quicker proof.
_inject_a_move_group_kill_at_the_stow: A move_group SIGABRT is intermittent and cannot be forced from inside the mission, and the mission process does NOT own the move_group pid (launch.py does), so NO repo code signals it -- the injection is an integration-lane step the lane owns because it owns the single-GPU boot (at that moment only this lane's move_group is planning). To force the EXACT coldlive failure deterministically: tail the mission console for the stow (the controller prints 'MANIP ... phase=... stow' / the port logs a plan_accept for the begin_joint_goal transport stow), then from the host-stack shell send SIGABRT to the planning process: `kill -ABRT $(pgrep -f 'move_group' )` (confirm a single pid first; the guard pins ROS_DOMAIN_ID so only this lane's node is up). move_group respawns (launch respawn=True, respawn_delay=3.0).
_expected_pass: The run is PASS for THIS lane in either of two ways: (a) no move_group death occurs and the collect carries + stows normally (the fix is inert, byte-identical -- the no-crash path never enters the recovery); or (b) a move_group exit-code-6 death occurs at (or during) the stow re-plan and host-stack.log / the mission console show, in order: 'process has died ... move_group ... exit code -6' -> a MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY line (the new 'op-phase fault ... action server gone -> holding for respawn + scene re-sync instead of e-stop (retry N/3)', OR the server-down 'awaiting respawn', OR the fm404 plan-result wall-deadline retry) -> 'MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY resending plan goal after respawn (retry N/3)' -> the stow completes -> the collect stage ends cleanly. There must be NO terminal 'MANIP_HOST_FAILED ... reason="host emergency stop"' and NO 'arm heartbeat lost' for the injected death (those are the pre-fix coldlive failure). The escalation path (bounded) is also acceptable as a correct outcome IF move_group genuinely never respawns: after MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY_MAX (3) holds or RESPAWN_WAIT_CAP_S the run fails with a NAMED reason ('move_group did not respawn within 45s') rather than a bare e-stop.
_what_to_grep: grep -nE 'exit code -6|move_group' host-stack.log                               # the SIGABRT death
grep -n 'MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY' host-stack.log                                 # recovery fired (hold / re-sync / resend), in order
grep -n 'op-phase fault .* action server gone' host-stack.log                  # the NEW raise-path recovery this lane adds
grep -n 'resending plan goal after respawn' host-stack.log                     # the interrupted plan was retried
grep -n 'MANIP_HOST_FAILED .* host emergency stop' <mission-console>.log       # MUST be ABSENT for the injected death (pre-fix failure)
_no_config_keys: This proof needs NO mission runtime-config key -- the death-raise recovery is always-on in scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_adapter.py (poll() + _recover_movegroup_death_or_none) and self-disabling: it engages ONLY when poll() raises AND the action server is gone AND a plan goal + crash-retry budget remain, so a live-server rejection and the whole no-crash path are byte-identical. Combine with movegroup-respawn-collect-fragment.json (the PR #224 mid-carry re-attach proof) and collect-only-validation-fragment.json (the honest-collect press backstop) if desired; all three are orthogonal.

_suggested_env.RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH: UNSET for the faithful honest/live_pose carry (coldlive), or 1 for a faster deterministic carry+stow
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_RESPAWN_WAIT_CAP_S: optional (default 45) -- the wall cap on holding a move open for the respawn before the 'did not respawn' escalation; leave default
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_SENSOR_STREAM_WALL_BACKSTOP_S: keep the sim value (180) so a long respawn hold does not trip the /sensors wall backstop before the respawn completes
